title: Technician - J. Reopen a completed inspection
preconds: Logged in as Technician. Tech View. Per SV-8095 AC4, View Mode is NOT a gate for inspections. A line has a completed inspection.
steps:
1. Log in.
  2. Open the line with a completed inspection.
  3. Click Open against the inspection.
expected: Step 3: Reopen is NOT available - reopening a completed inspection requires WOL Delete (SV-8095 AC5). A plain Technician cannot reopen unless granted Delete via a custom role.
